title: Dataset Public Benchmark Response
description: PUT /api/v1/datasets/{dataset_id}/public-benchmark 200 response. Success envelope (response_handler.success_response): {success, message, data: {dataset_id, public_benchmark}} (TraigentBackend src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py set_dataset_public_benchmark). The change is audited (DATASET_PUBLIC_BENCHMARK_CHANGED) in the same transaction; a change that cannot be audited is not applied.

dataset_id.description: The dataset whose flag was set (the dataset_id path parameter).

public_benchmark.description: The flag's value after the change.
